items.transcript: How to clean your dishwasher like a housekeeper. Let's go! After removing the racks, you're gonna go down and check your filters. If they look a little like this, yeah, they need some washing. So pop them on the sink and we're gonna wash them later. Now it's time for some cleaning and yeah, this needs it. So some Dawn Power Wash and a Scrub Mommy sponge. That's literally all you need. Oh, and a tiny little brush for some small details. Look, we're keeping it simple. We don't need a thousand different products and a thousand different steps. Just cleaning like the old school way, okay? Don't forget to go back and wash the filter and even the plate that covers the filter. And of course, don't forget to also rinse thoroughly. And one place that you might not notice that is hiding dirt is the rails of the racks. To finish it all, you're gonna pop a dishwasher cleaning tablet in and run the cycle. That's it! Look at that! And now that all the racks and everything are clean, then you just put them back in. Don't forget to clean the outside as well. I mean, you're already cleaning this. And look at that, how pretty!

items.caption:
Do you dust before you start cleaning? You need to dust before cleaning that way you aren’t dragging around dust and hair when you’re cleaning!
•
#clean #dust #howto #tips #petpeeve
items.transcript: I think one of my biggest cleaning pet peeves as someone who used to be a professional housekeeper, and I also cleaned houses for over 10 years, is that I hate, hate, hate when people clean something without dusting it first. Listen, it's going to take you 10, 20 seconds to dust it with a Swiffer duster, but it's going to save you a bunch of time. Because if you don't dust first, you're just like spreading the dust back and forth. Or I hate when you're cleaning something and like a strand of hair is just like wet and you're just like moving it from side to side. All of that is avoidable if you just dust it first because the Swiffer duster is going to catch and grab all that hair and all that dust, making your job of cleaning much easier. So it's something that I learned early on when I started cleaning houses. Nobody taught me this, but I was like, I hate cleaning a toilet with like hair. So what do you do? You dust it first.

items.transcript: If your kitchen is clean, but it sinks, chances are the smell is coming out of one of these three places. Let's go. Number one, the fridge. Just go make sure that you don't have any spoiled food, and if you do, throw it away. Number two, your garbage disposal. It is super easy to clean. Just throw one of these things in there with hot water, turn it on, and you're done. Last but not least, your garbage. Yep, if your kitchen is clean, but it sinks, chances are it's your garbage. Take it out. How pretty!
